title: Unsupervised Visual Learning
weeklyTopics: Introduction to unsupervised learning; generative models
skills: deep generative models (vae, gan, normalizing flows, autoregressive)
video representation learning and motion estimation
critical reading and reviewing of research papers
workloadNotes: Seminar-based graduate course centered on reading and critiquing research papers. Weekly short paper reviews (2 lowest dropped), one group class presentation (groups of 3, 75-minute session with background + 2 papers + discussion), one problem set (~2/3 through semester) reviewing core concepts, and a self-directed final group project (groups up to 4: proposal, 4-page CVPR-format report, 5-minute presentation). Attendance required; missing more than two classes without excuse hurts the grade.
prerequisitesText: An introductory computer vision course (EECS 442, EECS 504, or equivalent).
textbooks: Goodfellow, Bengio, Courville, Deep Learning (free online, reference)
Szeliski, Computer Vision: Algorithms and Applications, 2nd ed. draft (free online, reference)
